subject.title: fix(feishu): use union_id as fallback for @mention detection in multi-bot groups

question: Should the Feishu multi-bot mention fix proceed as a union_id-based rewrite, switch to another cross-app identity strategy, or wait for broader Feishu multi-bot identity work?
rationale: The submitted branch is stale and conflicting, the proposed identity source is disputed by the linked issue, and the fix changes message admission behavior where a wrong choice can suppress or misroute Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

options.title: Supersede With Broader Feishu Work
options.body: Keep this PR as investigation context and close or replace it only after broader Feishu identity work lands with positive proof.

options.title: Accept Narrow union_id Direction
options.body: Maintainers can deliberately accept the union_id fallback only with explicit proof that it populates and tests for sibling paths.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework this branch on current main only after proving the stable bot identity source and covering all mention admission paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, requested changes on this exact PR, and identified the Feishu identity decision surface as non-mechanical.
